author: N6rL
content: Blocked by L2 (toolchain) and L3 (mutation testing tool choice and illegal-states convention). Scope: cargo fmt config (rustfmt.toml), cargo clippy configured warnings-as-errors, cargo-deny (license/security/duplicate-dep auditing — matters for dual-licensed open-core future), and the mutation testing tool (cargo mutants) configured with per-zone policy: core modules = survivors block; frontier modules = survivors advisory. Pre-commit and CI integration per the blocking matrix from L3. AC: cargo fmt --check passes; cargo clippy -- -D warnings passes on empty crate; cargo deny check passes; cargo mutants runs (even with trivial output on an empty crate). Rust-toolchain.toml pins the channel.
